verdict.rationale: Activepieces offers self-hosting and 'bring your own AI keys, run it on your own infrastructure' which gives users infrastructure-level control over where data lives, implying they can manage retention/deletion themselves. However, there is no explicit documentation of retention policies, data deletion APIs/UI, or log purging controls within the product itself. Missing for 10: explicit data retention settings, deletion/export APIs, documented retention periods for logs/run history, and any GDPR-style data erasure workflow.
